paragraphs: Fence Erectors first mark positions and use post drivers to dig holes. They set each post in concrete and check vertical alignment with a level. After lunch, they install mesh panels and rails, pull each section straight, and secure it. They finish by installing gates, cleaning the site, and measuring the next section.

In one sentence, Fence Erectors build boundaries. They mark layouts, dig holes, set posts, install mesh, align sections, and hang gates. The work requires judgment and physical skill, making them the field executors of fencing projects.
